item.title: ❗️ During the day,
item.description: ❗️ During the day, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued to deliver group strikes against Ukrainian defence industry enterprises, logistics centres as well as ports and vessels that used to support the Armed Forces of Ukraine. 💥 As a result, the following targets were hit by strike unmanned aerial vehicles: 📍 In Kiev region: ▪️ an industrial enterprise in Velikaya Aleksandrovka (Ukrdefence Company LLC) producing the Lyut reconnaissance and unmanned ground vehicles and Khizhak remote-controlled ground modules; ▪️ a transport and logistics centre in Brovary (Raben Ukraine transport and logistics complex), used for the storage and distribution of components for UAVs of various types including fixed-wing drones. 📍 In Odessa region: ▪️ in the port of Izmail, a tanker unloading POLs delivered to Ukraine as well as two fuel storage tanks intended for the Armed Forces of Ukraine; ▪️ in the port of Odessa, seven storage facilities containing military equipment intended to support the Armed Forces of Ukraine. ▪️ In addition, in the port of Odessa, an unmanned aerial vehicles workshop was hit. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 'It's better to move in the daytime. It's more dangerous at night'
item.description: 'It's better to move in the daytime. It's more dangerous at night' 💬 The storming soldier with the call sign 'Vysota' shared such an unusual detail of the assault. He took part in liberation of Nezhenka in Zaporozhye region. ▫️ It's all about a lot of mines and artificial obstacles, which the serviceman may not be able to see at night. ▫️ At the same time, it is impossible to stop in the open, and hostile drones are constantly spinning around in the sky. 'There was an open terrain of up to a kilometre. It was literally five to ten minutes to overcome them,' the storming soldier recalls. ▫️ Despite this, Russian troops did all they could and completed the task. Well done! 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ⚓️ Maloyaroslavets
item.description: ⚓️ Maloyaroslavets : 5th in the series ▫️ The Project 677 Lada diesel-electric submarine was laid at the Admiralty Shipyards in St. Petersburg. 💬 Commander-in-Chief of the Russian Navy Admiral of the Fleet Aleksandr Moiseyev stressed that the submarines of the project are the most modern in their class, thanks to their tactical and combat specifications. ✅ The fifth bastion: the submarine Maloyaroslavets is the fifth serial vessel of this project developed by the Rubin Central Design Bureau for Marine Engineering. 📑 A name with background: according to the tradition of the Lada Project, ships are named after Russian cities. The new submarine is named after a City of Military Glory in Kaluga region. It played a key role in the battles of 1812 and the Great Patriotic War. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29068

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
📍
The Sever Group of Forces improved its tactical situation
. Russian troops inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade, an airmobile brigade of the AFU, and a territorial defence brigade close to Ulanovo and Sadki (Sumy region).
💥
In Kharkov region,
strikes were delivered at formations of two mechanised brigades, an assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, two territorial defence brigades, and a national guard brigade close to Prikolotnoye, Berezhnoye, Petropavlovka, Liptsy, and Slatino (Kharkov region).
▪️
The AFU lost up to 245 troops, three armoured fighting vehicles, 14 motor vehicles, and one field artillery gun.
↗️
The Zapad Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions
. Russian troops inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades of the Armed Forces of Ukraine and a territorial defence brigade near Proletarskoye (Kharkov region), Sidorovo, Mayaki, and Krestishche (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy losses amounted to up to 210 troops, 20 motor vehicles, two artillery guns, and four electronic warfare stations.
📍
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces improved the tactical situation along the front line
. Strikes were delivered at formations of two mechanised brigades, a motorised infantry brigade, an assault brigade, and a mountain assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine near Kramatorsk, Druzhkovka, Semenovka, and Nikolayevka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy lost more than 190 troops, 30 motor vehicles, and three field artillery guns.
↗️
The Tsentr Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions
. Manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, an airborne brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, a marine brigade, and two national guard brigades have been hit near Ivanovka, Novopavlovka (Dnepropetrovsk region), Andreyevka, Dobropolye, and Belozerskoye (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 390 troops, one Kazak armoured fighting vehicle, eight motor vehicles, two artillery guns, and three radars.
👉
See Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

as of 27 August 2026

🚩
The Vostok Group of Forces continued to advance to the depths of the enemy defence and liberated Shevchenkovskoye in Zaporozhye region as a result of resolute actions
.
🔥
Strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware
of two assault brigades, two air assault brigades, and two assault regiments of the Armed Forces of Ukraine close to Trudovoye, Otrishki, Omelnik, Barvinovka (Zaporozhye region), Mirovka, and Vasilkovka (Dnepropetrovsk region).
▪️
The enemy losses amounted to more than 360 troops, five armoured fighting vehicles, and seven motor vehicles.
💥
The Dnepr Group of Forces inflicted losses
on manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade of the AFU and a territorial defence brigade near Dimitrovo, Orekhov, and Novoyakovlevka (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
Up to 55 troops, 19 motor vehicles, and two electronic warfare stations were neutralised.
✈️
Operational-Tactical Aviation, attack drones, missile troops, and artillery of the Russian Groups of Forces
have inflicted damage on logistics centres, fuel, power, transport, and port infrastructures of Ukraine employed by the AFU, ammunition depots and workshops of unmanned aerial vehicles as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations and foreign mercenaries in 145 areas.
▫️
Air defence systems shot down
19 guided aerial bombs, two U.S.-made HIMARS MLRS projectiles, and 591 fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles.
📊

since the beginning of the special military operation,

▫️
1,775
MLRS combat vehicles,
▫️
36,284
field artillery guns and mortars

item.title: ❗️ Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, First Deputy Defence Minister, General of the Army Valery Gerasimov
item.description: ❗️ Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, First Deputy Defence Minister, General of the Army Valery Gerasimov inspected the course of combat missions carried out by formations and units of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces. 💬 In the framework of the inspection, at the command post of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces, General of the Army Valery Gerasimov was briefed by the Group's Commander, Colonel General Sergei Medvedev, on the current situation in the area of responsibility as well as by commanders of formations on the results of combat missions. ✅ The Chief of General Staff summing up results noted the success of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces in liberating the Donetsk People's Republic and set tasks for further action. ▫️ Moreover, General of the Army Valery Gerasimov presented state awards to the most distinguished servicemen and thanked them for their courage and heroism during combat operations. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29064

❗️
Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, First Deputy Defence Minister, General of the Army Valery Gerasimov
inspected the course of combat missions carried out by formations and units of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces.
💬
In the framework of the inspection, at the command post of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces, General of the Army Valery Gerasimov
was briefed by the Group's Commander, Colonel General Sergei Medvedev,
on the current situation in the area of responsibility
as well as by commanders of formations
on the results of combat missions.
✅
The Chief of General Staff summing up results
noted the success of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces
in liberating the Donetsk People's Republic and
set tasks for further action.
▫️
Moreover, General of the Army Valery Gerasimov
presented state awards to the most distinguished servicemen
and thanked them for their courage and heroism during combat operations.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
